literal: she with tight bracelets - having done - departed - stealth - great sorrow - which cures - medicine - one - it possesses
translation: The stealthy glance the woman with tight bracelets cast as she departed holds a medicine that cures my great sorrow.
modern: நெருங்கிய வளையல்களை அணிந்தவள் என்னை விட்டுச் செல்லும்போது காட்டிய குறிப்பு, என் பெருந்துயரைத் தீர்க்கும் ஒரு மருந்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது.
explanation: The speaker reflects on the subtle, secret sign given by his lover as they parted. The phrase ceṟitoṭi refers to the woman through the imagery of her close-fitting bracelets. The stealth (kaḷḷam) she showed while departing is her hidden expression of love or promise to return. This secret sign acts as a medicine (maruntu) that cures the intense sorrow (uṟutuyar) of their separation, giving him hope and comfort.
